answer: Pay per task only against bonded outside demand. A task starts its voyage when a client posts a bond naming the work and citing the current beacon output, so demand cannot be backdated; payout draws solely from that bond minus a burned fee. Sybil clones merely echo their owner's capital — a self-dealing loop returns the bond minus the burn each cycle — so N fake workers and clients bleed instead of minting. Membership stays open; income is rationed. Needs real outside demand and truly retired fees.
